summary: The background pass that proposes new notes can now look things up before it writes: earlier messages of the room, memory, the notebook, the room's members, the calendar and the web, up to five reads per pass.
details: It holds every read-only tool the runtime allows for a room-keyed pass, derived from the tool registry, except the image and video reader (a separate model call each) and the Instagram, LinkedIn and X readers (they use the social bridge's logged-in session).
A message it read through a tool can be cited in the note it proposes, exactly like a message from the batch; every check on what a note may say is unchanged.

A new per-pass ceiling, [dreamer.budgets.<pass>] max_tool_calls, bounds tool calls over every verb together; past it the pass is told the reads are spent, and nora_dream_guard_vetoes_total{rule="pass-budget"} counts it.
limitations: The budget numbers (5 tool calls, 8 turns, 240 s) are starting points, not measurements; the first live read-back sizes them.
The ceiling is per model sample: with candidate_samples above 1, a fire may make that many times five calls.
